keepSeconds.description:
the "Keep these display settings?" toast's countdown, seconds (5..60)

Takes a whole number 5 .. 60. Default: 15.

identifyDelayMs.description:
a pointer resting this long on a tile shows that screen's name on the screen itself, ms (0..2000)

Takes a whole number 0 .. 2000. Default: 250.

newDisplay.description:
a display never seen before says so, with Mirror / Only external / Arrange...

Takes true or false. Default: true.

unplug.description:
"<display> disconnected"

Takes true or false. Default: true.

openTab.description:
the tab the popup opens on: "situation" (the displays when there is more than one or something to settle, else the presets) |
"displays" | "presets" | "last"

Takes "situation", "displays", "presets" or "last". Default: "situation".

cast.description:
casting to a TV (Miracast) from the Displays view: a found TV appears as a chip beside the canvas. OFF until you try it
(the Wi-Fi card may drop for ~8 s while pairing; docs/agent_added_files_and_folders/panorama/CAST.md)

Takes true or false. Default: false.

audio.description: Takes true or false. Default: true.

castQuality.description: a TV you have not set up yet: the picture's size, its frames a second (10..60), its bit rate, and whether the sound goes along

portLabels.description:
the port words in a display's name ("HDMI · Sony TV"): laptop, hdmi, usbc, displaylink, dvi, vga, virtual, cast, other

Default: {}.
